query:
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(CAST(gdate_happened AS STRING), 1, 10) AS violation_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_description = 'Issued to violator and paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_violations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_description = 'Issued to violator but un-paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_violations,
  COUNT(*) AS total_violations
FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation
WHERE status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
  AND gdate_happened IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(gdate_happened AS STRING), 1, 10)
ORDER BY violation_date
